doc.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The big-band era ends
summary: Big bands were phasing out, and Cab went to a small group a couple of years after Barker left.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: After ’46 when you left Cab’s band, you got . . . you didn’t continue with the big bands, you got into doing . . .
There was no more big . . . Big bands was phasing out. I was out of Cab’s band maybe two years when the band broke up. Cab went with a small group, about seven pieces.
How did you quit Cab, by the way?
